title: Prove end-to-end parallel roadmap execution across working models
goal: Build an offline end-to-end test through production scheduler, task claims, isolated worktrees, model dispatch and task close, using at least three different working fake models and multiple independent tasks plus a dependency chain. A synchronization barrier must prove execution overlap, not merely multiple configured models or serial fallback. Inject insufficient credit and temporary lockout into one worker while others finish; verify reassignment, shared-account quota ceilings, budgets, cancellation, restart, edit conflicts and acceptance failure. Every reported completed task has passing acceptance and a closed queue record; blocked tasks remain honest. Record elapsed time, cost and quality against sequential execution without claiming speedup unless measured. Implement nonzero tests named parallel_roadmap_e2e_* in the production owning crate.
